scope: Finalized YCB-V ledgers/CSV/source/calibration and existing primary official score files audited on CPU. No GT poses, evaluator, locks, inference, GPU or worker jobs invoked; prior audits not rerun.

audit.denominator_policy: Unmodified complete official localization targets, including blocked and failed rows

identity_verification.scope_limit: Saved RGB/depth source fingerprints are joined to the original acquisition manifest; full raw-image decodes/rehashes and prior sampled point-mapping tests are not repeated.

BOP_average_time_metric_scope.note: Toolkit average over images represented in the prediction CSV. All-attempt image active time is separately summed; CAD onboarding is excluded.

CAD_onboarding.scope: Sum of saved completed-stage active runtimes; partial progress is separate. Failed/unfinished CAD work after its last checkpoint, including a failing GeDi tail, is not fully logged and is not included.

runtime_scope.policy: Image runtime includes saved failed work and retained completed-candidate compute, excludes interruption downtime, CAD onboarding and evaluation.

onboarding_physical_counts.scope: Physical completion IDs and saved runtimes only; no all-CAD deep checks repeated.

prior_separate_reviews.scope: Prior separate scoped evidence, not repeated.
Prior separate scoped evidence, not repeated.

preservation_action: Only this new separate final audit is written. Source, inputs, feature caches, predictions, primary receipts, scores, blockers, summaries and status remain unchanged.
